name: Dangling Gateway API backend
description: A Gateway API route (HTTPRoute, TCPRoute, UDPRoute) whose backendRef references a Service that does not exist in the target namespace silently routes nowhere. Only Service backends are validated; non-Service backends (custom resources) are skipped.
remediation: Create the referenced Service or correct the route backendRef.
test: Check that every Gateway API backendRef targeting a core Service resolves to an existing Service.
